sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Stat Jump (the app, "we", "us") is run by an independent developer based in New York, USA. It measures your jump from a video you choose and suggests drills. Questions about these terms: hello@statjump.app.

sections.heading: Accepting these terms
paragraphs: By downloading or using Stat Jump you agree to these terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

sections.heading: Who can use Stat Jump
paragraphs: You must be at least 13 years old. If you are under 18, you need a parent or guardian’s permission, and they must agree to these terms for you. If you buy a subscription as a parent or guardian, you are responsible for it.

sections.heading: What the app does, and what it does not
paragraphs: Stat Jump analyzes your video on your phone and gives you measurements such as jump height, with scores and drill ideas. These are estimates. Accuracy depends on how you film: the camera angle, lighting, your clothing and the setup you entered in your profile. Results can be wrong.

Stat Jump is not medical, athletic-training or professional advice, and it does not diagnose or treat anything. Do not rely on it to decide about an injury, a health condition or a recruiting or selection decision.

sections.heading: Safety
paragraphs: Jumping and training carry a risk of injury. Warm up first, use a safe space and sensible footwear, and stop right away if you feel pain or dizziness. Talk to a coach, doctor or other qualified professional before starting a new program, especially if you are injured, recovering or have a health condition. You do the jumps and drills at your own risk.

sections.heading: Free tier and Stat Jump Pro
paragraphs: Free: your first analysis is fully unlocked. After that you get one analysis a week with headline numbers. Your history and sharing are always free.

Stat Jump Pro unlocks unlimited analyses and the full breakdown on every jump. It is offered as a yearly or a monthly subscription. We may change what is free and what is Pro in future versions of the app.

sections.heading: Subscriptions and billing
paragraphs: Stat Jump Pro is billed by Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play) through your store account, in the price and currency shown before you confirm. We do not receive your payment details. We use RevenueCat to check whether your subscription is active.

Subscriptions renew automatically for the same length of time unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your store account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends.

To manage or cancel, open your Apple ID or Google Play subscription settings. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription. Cancelling stops the next renewal and you keep Pro until the end of the period you paid for.
Refunds are handled by Apple or Google under their policies, not by us. We cannot issue refunds for store purchases.

Prices may change. If a price goes up, we will give notice as the store requires, and you can cancel before it takes effect. If you subscribed at the founding yearly price, you keep that price for as long as your subscription stays continuously active. If it lapses, the current price applies if you resubscribe.

sections.heading: Your content
paragraphs: Your videos are analyzed on your device and stay there. We do not upload or receive them. You own your videos and your results, and we claim no rights in them.

You are responsible for what you record and share. Only film people who have agreed to it (and, for anyone under 18, whose parent or guardian has agreed), and only share what you have the right to share. When you share a showcase video, you decide where it goes and the app you share it with handles it under its own terms.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Do not use Stat Jump to break the law or anyone’s rights, to film or share people without their permission, or to harass or harm others. Do not copy, reverse engineer, decompile or extract the code or analysis models, try to get around the free limit or the Pro checks, interfere with the app or our servers, or use the app to build a competing product. Do not present edited or fabricated results as real measurements.

The Privacy Policy explains what each receives. Their services are governed by their own terms, and we are not responsible for them.

We may suspend or end your access if you break these terms or if we stop offering the app. Sections that by their nature should continue, such as ownership, disclaimers and limits of liability, survive.

We will post the new version in the app and on statjump.app/terms with a new date, and for material changes we will give notice in the app. If you keep using the app after a change takes effect, you accept it. If you do not agree, stop using the app.

This does not take away any mandatory consumer protections you have where you live. Before starting any claim, please contact us at hello@statjump.app so we can try to resolve it.
